caption: Supplementary Fig. 28 | Environmental contrasts and lifecycle asymmetry across time windows. a,b, Associations of six environmental factors with signed A (a) and individual absolute asymmetry A (b). Matrix columns distinguish 12 h, primary 24 h and full-segment windows on window-specific and common-SID support. Both panels share a zero-centred colour bar showing change per fixed observed SD. All 72 estimates are shown; model samples range from 1,810 to 2,197 cyclones. Values are changes in A or A per fixed observed SD of the post-minus-pre contrast. Outlined cells have BH q<0.05. Table S2k reports every estimate, marginal 95% SID-percentile interval from 2,000 draws, scale, count and P/q value. P values use HC1 covariance with a normal reference; BH adjustment covers twelve tests separately within each of six window-by-support families. A compares genesis-to-first-LMI and last-LMI-to-termination durations and excludes the intervening LMI span. These are conditional timing associations without an intervention interpretation.
